description: This file contains utility functions for testing and manipulating disk cache entries in the Chromium project, including creating corrupt files, removing or corrupting SHA256 hashes, and corrupting stream lengths.

methods.name: CreateCorruptFileForTests
methods.description: Creates a dummy file at the specified cache path with a given key, used for testing corruption scenarios.

methods.name: RemoveKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Removes the SHA256 hash from a cache entry file by modifying its EOF record and truncating the file.

methods.name: CorruptKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Overwrites the SHA256 hash in a cache entry file with corrupt data.

methods.name: CorruptStream0LengthFromEntry
methods.description: Modifies the stream size in the EOF record to an invalid large value to simulate corruption.
